title: Best Time to Buy & Sell Stock
kidExplanation: Stock prices across days. Buy once, sell once later. Maximize profit (or take zero).
plainProblem: Best Time to Buy & Sell Stock: Stock prices across days. Worked example — input: prices = [7,1,5,3,6,4]; expected output: 5. Why: Buy 1 sell 6. Interview pattern to name out loud: Sliding window.

thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: For “Best Time to Buy & Sell Stock”, first say a correct slow approach: scan or retry every candidate until the example works by hand. Input prices = [7,1,5,3,6,4] should still produce 5.

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the nested work. If each choice restarts a full scan, time blows up. Name the cost before optimizing — interviewers want that honesty. Target after the insight: O(n).

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To find the maximum profit from a single buy and sell transaction in the input array 'prices', we can use a simple one-pass approach. We initialize two variables, 'min_price' to keep track of the minimum price seen so far, and 'max_profit' to store the maximum profit. We iterate through the 'prices' array, and for each price, we update the 'min_price' if we find a smaller price. We also calculate the potential profit if we sell at the current price and update 'max_profit' if the current profit is greater than the previous maximum profit.

thinkingSteps.title: Better idea
thinkingSteps.body: Commit to Sliding window. Longest/shortest subarray or substring with a condition. Walk example `prices = [7,1,5,3,6,4]` → `5` while naming each variable, then code. Close with O(n) time and O(1) space.
